_comment: Figures transcribed from the documents in sources/ for data/commuter-parameters.json. transitMonthly_132f2A records the transit amount as the year's revenue procedure printed it; where Congress later changed it, verifier-config.mjs reconciles that field to the as-corrected data value and the correction is recorded beside it.

_sources.usc-26-132: 26 U.S.C. 132 (2024 edition), subsection (f) and its amendment notes
_sources.pl-105-178: Transportation Equity Act for the 21st Century, Pub. L. 105-178, section 9010
_sources.pl-110-343: Emergency Economic Stabilization Act of 2008, Pub. L. 110-343, div. B section 211 (bicycle commuting)
_sources.pl-111-5: American Recovery and Reinvestment Act of 2009, Pub. L. 111-5, section 1151 (transit parity)
_sources.pl-112-240: American Taxpayer Relief Act of 2012, Pub. L. 112-240, section 203 (transit parity through 2013)
_sources.pl-113-295: Tax Increase Prevention Act of 2014, Pub. L. 113-295 div. A, section 103 (transit parity through 2014)
_sources.pl-114-113: Protecting Americans from Tax Hikes Act of 2015, Pub. L. 114-113 div. Q, section 105 (permanent parity)
_sources.pl-119-21: Pub. L. 119-21, section 70112 (bicycle commuting repeal and indexing base)
_sources.rp-10-40: Rev. Proc. 2010-40, section 2.01, deferring the 2011 IRC 132(f) amounts to Rev. Proc. 2011-12
_sources.rp-13-15: Rev. Proc. 2013-15, 2013 amounts and the section 3 correction of 2012
